notes: Measured on the ToFuture Windows host against the 3.7.3 release tree. The full suite was run with the portable Git and Windows PowerShell v1.0 directories on PATH; without powershell.exe on PATH the two DPAPI claims fail for an environment reason, not a code reason. The suite was run with --test-concurrency=1. The GPW-V2 gate suite covers the five levels, workspace/outside classification, credential and system paths, blacklists, shell redirection/interpreter pipes, relative blacklists and the sub-plugin mount. The real Loader suite installed the packed 3.7.3 artifact into a throwaway DSH_HOME under the real DSH runtime; one archive-tab probe is explicitly skipped unless W2M_SURFACES_PROBE=1. The desktop profile was not mutated by this audit.
